fields.name: limit
fields.description: Maximum items to return per page. Range: 1-72, default 20.

fields.name: offset
fields.description: Number of items to skip for pagination. Default 0.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Ecliptic longitude in degrees, 0 inclusive to 360 exclusive, measured from 0 Aries. Returns the single name governing that degree instead of the list. 360 is rejected because it is the same point as 0 and the arcs are half open at the top.
